name: Sally Pretorius
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Plano, Texas
education: Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law
about: Texas native family law attorney Sally Pretorius is a 2009 graduate of Southern Methodist University (SMU) in Dallas, Texas. Sally has always been passionate about helping others and has practiced family law since 2010 when she transitioned from civil litigation. Sally has represented numerous clients both in and out of the courtroom as they face what is often the most difficult part of their lives. Her passion is to help children make the best transition possible.

Sally enjoys the “people side” of the practice, and especially loves the litigation aspect of being a family law attorney. When she is not in the courtroom, she enjoys coaching law students in mock trial competitions and guest lecturing at the law school on litigation topics. Sally is a natural public speaker, who during law school helped her mock trial team win the regional level, and advance to the semi-final round of the national level of the ABA Labor and Employment competition.
